 Introducing Orange Builder: From a Sketch to a Working Brand Site in Minutes
Orange Builder turns those inputs into responsive pages using your brand guidelines and the governed assets already in Orange DAM. You shape the result through conversation and decide what goes live.
Speed is only half the problem
Brand sites take a long time to launch because they’re built by hand, page by page. General-purpose AI web builders fix the speed, but they work outside your DAM. Every logo and image gets copied in and has to be tracked separately. Before long, it’s unclear whether the assets are approved, current versions.
Brand teams need both: AI speed, and pages built from the files they already govern. Here's what that looks like with Orange Builder.
Build in minutes
Orange Builder handles layouts, asset selection, component creation and responsive checks. If your design needs a component that doesn’t exist, the agent builds it. Repeated elements can become reusable blocks.
In internal tests, Orange Builder turned an unformatted PDF into a working About Us page in about 2 minutes 20 seconds, including responsive checks. A page built from a Figma design took under 9 minutes. 
Brand teams spend their time on the brand instead of on building pages.
Change it by asking
“Add a photography guidelines page.” “Darken the accent color.” “Keep the header visible as people scroll.”
Orange Builder applies each change where it belongs. Updates to shared colors, fonts or headers carry across every page that uses them. The agent checks desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts before you review the result.
In one internal test, a request to keep the header visible was applied across the site in about 90 seconds, checks included.
Build directly from your DAM
Orange Builder uses the governed logos, images and files already in Orange DAM. The agent finds suitable assets, or uses the ones you choose. New assets are saved back into the DAM with your approval.
Your site stays connected to one governed library. Brand and legal teams can trust what is on the page.
Keep control of the result
Your team decides when to publish. Refine pages through conversation or use the visual editor to adjust content, layout, typography and navigation.
Personal staging copies let team members work on the same experience, while version history lets you restore earlier work.
Put it to work
Use Orange Builder for brand sites, partner portals, press rooms and campaign microsites alongside your existing CMS. The agent can also rebuild existing Orange Logic brand portals for your team to review and refine. Your account team can help plan the transition.
You bring the vision. AI handles the busywork.
Compress weeks or months of work into an afternoon. Bring your brand guidelines and see Orange Builder in action.

Teams rely on it to get content to market faster while maintaining governance and connecting it to business outcomes.
